name: clawd-buddy
description: Clawd, an animated pixel mascot above the prompt. He reacts to what Claude is doing and keeps you company while you wait.

side.title: Side
side.description: Where Clawd stands above the prompt.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Only the base pose and calm variants, no pastimes.

idleSeconds.title: Idle time before pastimes (s)
idleSeconds.description: Seconds without activity before Clawd starts passing the time.

nightStart.title: Night starts (hour)
nightStart.description: From this hour Clawd gets sleepy when idle.

nightEnd.title: Night ends (hour)
nightEnd.description: If it is earlier than the start, the night runs past midnight.

iceWhenCold.title: Ice when the cache is cold
iceWhenCold.description: Now and then Clawd freezes in a block of ice while the prompt cache is cold. Typing cracks it, sending breaks it.

birthday.title: Birthday (DD.MM.)
birthday.description: On this day Clawd celebrates with cake and a party hat. Empty: off.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the texts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /clawd language.
